title: Supplementary Benefits Annex to the Travel Protection Plans Range
content:
Beyond the principal covers, a Travel Protection Plans plan may carry a rental vehicle damage benefit per rental with its own deductible, a business equipment benefit per insured traveller, a kennel or pet care benefit where the traveller's return is delayed, and cover for the listed adventure sports. The figures are in USD.

| Plan | Rental vehicle damage, per rental | Rental damage deductible | Business equipment, per traveller | Kennel or pet care | Listed adventure sports |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Trip Basics Essential | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | excluded |
| Trip Basics Standard | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | excluded |
| TripGuard Plus | 25000.00 | 250.00 | 500.00 | 150.00 | excluded |
| TripGuard Premier | 35000.00 | 100.00 | 1000.00 | 300.00 | covered |
| Cancel For Any Reason Elite | 35000.00 | 100.00 | 1000.00 | 300.00 | covered |
| Annual Multi-Trip Traveller | 25000.00 | 250.00 | 1500.00 | 300.00 | excluded |
| Annual Multi-Trip Executive | 50000.00 | 0.00 | 3000.00 | 500.00 | covered |

Reading a nil figure: where the limit in a column stands at 0.00 the plan carries no benefit of that kind, as the two Trip Basics plans do for rental vehicle damage, business equipment and pet care alike. A deductible of 0.00 beside a limit above nothing is a different matter: on Annual Multi-Trip Executive the rental vehicle damage benefit of 50000.00 is carried with nothing withheld from it.

The business equipment benefit does not follow the plan order exactly: Annual Multi-Trip Traveller carries 1500.00, above the 1000.00 of TripGuard Premier and of Cancel For Any Reason Elite, while its rental vehicle damage benefit of 25000.00 sits below theirs.

The listed adventure sports are covered on three plans — TripGuard Premier, Cancel For Any Reason Elite and Annual Multi-Trip Executive — and excluded on the other four.
